### 2026-10-24 – made a stand for the thing. Realized that it looks like a half life, so i didnt

**0.78h**

made a stand for the thing. Realized that it looks like a half life, so i didnt

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/W1c28oFzhqawCAaFFBFieXuylI2NJFjr/667eb227bea912bb5a126144ea20d41211f895f55370da96aa6df354ef7dd3f7.png)

Also making BOM

Also in the sidelines im coding. Coding update: my initial pitch slider method is to seperate the slider into 5 octaves, and within each octave getting the remainder for the bend. However, the bend is limited to +/- 2, and some bs happens when it crosses an octave boundary. So I'm going to be changing it to using RPN +/- 12 semitones (equivalent in cents) from middle c. Tldr giving me 3 octaves (middle c, one lower, one higher)
